Orrama for Mac (Apple silicon) and Windows. Your notes stay on your computer, as plain Markdown files.

**Which file?** On a Mac, `Orrama_<version>_aarch64.dmg`. On Windows, `Orrama_<version>_x64-setup.exe`. Ignore `latest.json` and the `.sig` and `.tar.gz` files: Orrama uses them to update itself.

**Mac.** Open the .dmg, agree to the licence, and drag Orrama to Applications. Open it. The first time, the Mac says "Apple could not verify…": choose Done, then open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll down to "Orrama was blocked", choose Open Anyway and type your password. You only do this once.

**Windows.** Open the setup file. If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", choose More info, then Run anyway. If it says Smart App Control blocked it, with no Run anyway, Orrama can't be installed on that PC yet: tell Jules (the Microsoft Store version will get round it).

**Updating.** Orrama checks for a new version when it opens and every six hours, and asks Restart now or Later.

**Backing up.** Settings → Notes → Back up now makes one .zip with your notes and everything else. To move to a new computer, install Orrama there and choose "I have a backup" on the first screen.

**Uninstalling never deletes your notes.** They stay in the Orrama folder in your home folder (or the folder you chose).

The full guide, with where everything is kept: https://github.com/JewelsArt/orrama/blob/main/docs/install.md
